entities.name: Tupaia virus phosphoprotein Q4VKV7
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Tupaia virus phosphoprotein Q4VKV7 (100% identity and full-length coverage; E-value 1.46e-233).
Essential component of the viral RNA polymerase transcription/replication complex; binds viral ribonucleocapsid and positions L polymerase on template.
May chaperone newly synthesized free N protein (N(0)); also contributes to virion assembly.
UniProt GO annotation includes viral transcription (GO:0019083) and host cell cytoplasm (GO:0030430).

entities.name: Viral transcription
observations: The exact-match reference phosphoprotein is annotated for viral transcription and participates in the RNA polymerase transcription/replication complex.

entities.name: Viral genome replication
observations: Reference annotation places phosphoprotein in the viral RNA polymerase transcription and replication complex; this supports a role in viral genome replication.
